facts.fact: 终轮开打前她的真恐惧：怕自己太骄傲不退赛，逼出隐藏的 Syphon 面
facts.anchor: Inara feared what would happen when she reached the point of no return.

facts.fact: 火法师先来一个、再添三名——四火围杀远超常规考题
储备见底：鼻耳渗血、视野发黑、盾缩到跪地——她已进 reserves
facts.anchor: Blood seeped from her nose and ears.

facts.fact: Felix 揭牌：他早知道她是 Syphon，抓着她的脚踝主动让她吸取，力量远超想象
盾的新用法：裹住火焰拧拳抽氧——无氧火灭，士兵窒息
facts.anchor: she slowly began to squeeze her hands into tight fists, drawing the oxygen out of their air

facts.fact: 胜利瞬间黑暗之声催她吸干杀光；掌声把它打断
facts.anchor: Take more. It’s not enough. More. More. Drain them all. Kill them all.

facts.fact: 全场起立：高议会震惊畏怯、Larissa 张口、Walder 眯眼凝视表情难辨
facts.anchor: an indecipherable expression on his face
